theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_pp_stratum_card
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a j : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ j → j < a → Nat.card {z : ZMod (p ^ a) // p ^ j ∣ z.val ∧ ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ z.val} = Nat.totient (p ^ min j (a - j)) * p ^ (a - 2 * j)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
